purpose: controlled occlusion-like diagnostic, not a claim about UTUAV occlusion labels
base_detection: GT-synthetic: 3% box jitter, 15% independent dropout, seed 0
block_gap: For each moving GT track with at least 20 annotated frames, select 1/2 tracks by sha256(sequence:track_id) parity. For selected tracks remove 8 consecutive detections centered at the median observed frame. Keep GT intact.
tracker_policy: same four pre-existing ByteTrack KF/EKF/UKF/PF100 configs, same cache per filter, PF seeds 0/1/2
score_policy: TrackEval HOTA/IDF1/IDSW on both selected 120-frame validation windows; repeat motorcycle-only stratification
